about_the_game:
Take to the skies in this Air Force-themed pinball table, packed with high-flying action and military-inspired challenges!

✈️ Authentic Air Force design – Navigate an action-packed table featuring fighter jets, military bases, and high-stakes missions.
🎯 Mission system – Engage in thrilling air combat-inspired objectives, including a special mission hive base where airplanes deploy as a bonus.
🛫 Three ramps and bumpers – Use skillful shots to navigate the table’s intricate layout.
🎮 Bonus section – Aim for a hidden area where you can score big by landing the ball inside.
🧩 Dynamic puzzles – Solve unique challenges integrated into gameplay.
🔧 Realistic pinball physics, including multi-ball mechanics for high-speed action.
🏆 Steam high score tracking – Compete to be the top pilot on the leaderboard.
🎶 Immersive soundtrack, featuring military-themed music, jet engine sound effects, and pilot voiceovers.
🎵 Music-controlled levels, where gameplay reacts dynamically to the soundtrack.

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunge
